days.note: Header read off the graphic: ULTRA MUSIC FESTIVAL, MARCH 18 19 20 2016, DOWNTOWN MIAMI, and a SET TIMES section with one block per stage per day, headed FRI 18, SAT 19 or SUN 20, each "LISTED BY SET TIME". It is the graphic the 2016 lineup page embedded (Wayback capture 20160327083656). Every set prints a start only, so every row is open-ended. Stage names are the stage logos, uppercased; ULTRA WORLDWIDE is recorded as WORLDWIDE STAGE, the name its later grids print. The third stage prints carl cox & FRIENDS on Friday and Saturday and I'M IN A STATE OF TRANCE on Sunday; each day keeps its printed name. RESISTANCE prints "powered by ARCADIA SPIDER" and is recorded as RESISTANCE. Names are kept as printed, including LIVE when it prints in the same type as the name. Each ARCADIA LANDING SHOW row is the stage show, printed between sets; the show-segment rule drops it at build.
days.method: every block in the graphic compared with its row: billing, stage column, start and end
